Own app/__main__.py (single-command wrapper that boots BOTH services; a convenience wrapper only, not a lifecycle — the harness starts and kills the two services independently), app/ledgerd.py (ledgerd entrypoint: bind and listen within 10s of process start even while the vendor is down for the first 3–8s, serve local data, expose the degraded state, and complete the first sync unprompted once the vendor returns; wires in the API slice's endpoints), app/db.py (ledger.db schema: payments, reversals, events, outbox, plus indexes that keep GET /api/payments limit=50 under 150ms p95 while a sync runs with 8 concurrent readers and SSE live), app/sync.py (walk the vendor's paginated payments list — 192 pages of 64 at fixture count — upserting into ledger.db so an already-present payment is updated, never duplicated, and syncing twice does not change the count; also fetch GET /v3/reversals so reversal truth survives a webhook outage; resume per the docs after a dropped connection mid-page-stream; honour Retry-After on a 500 with a single documented retry then continue — never a fresh unconditional restart of committed work; restart the cursor on 410 cursor_expired), app/ledger.py (append-only event log: every applied state change appends EXACTLY one event, seq strictly increasing and contiguous from 1, frozen type vocabulary payment.created|payment.updated|reversal.created|draft.created|draft.submitted|draft.approved|draft.rejected|payment.sent, rfc3339 UTC at), app/outbox.py (the five notifier-bound event types written to the outbox table in the SAME SQLite transaction as the state change — no commit-then-POST or POST-then-commit; background relay delivers rows to notifierd via POST /notify/events in batches of at most 50, ascending seq, retrying with backoff capped at 2s, at-least-once, marking delivered only after a 200). Owns the payments collection model from section 2: N = 12,288 exactly at fixture load, run-time creates append; the window spans 96 consecutive Europe/Berlin calendar days containing exactly one of the four listed DST transitions, at least 7 days from both ends. Enforces the graded consistency rules: no invented (payment_id, version) states, per-key versions strictly increasing in event-log order. Cross-refs: app/notifierd.py is owned by the notifierd slice (the wrapper imports its entrypoint); all HTTP endpoint code is owned by the api slice; global Rules (minor-unit integers end to end, no cross-currency sums, instant-based time) apply here.
